text:
Maya (CS): Heads-up: several EU onboarding CSV ingest jobs are stuck in "processing" and some return 502 when hitting the webhook gateway since ~03:03 UTC. Affects both trials and a couple of paid accounts with renewals in 2 weeks.
Tom (SRE): We're seeing increased 5xxs from webhook-proxy-eu at 03:01 due to a downstream timeout to the indexing service.
Ivy (Eng): Confirmed. A transient spike in indexing latency exhausted worker slots; requests were throttled and timed out.
Maya (CS): Which customers are impacted and who owns comms? Need exec contacts for the renewal-risk ones.
Evelyn (CS Lead): I've flagged 3 accounts with renewal signals. Jordan (AM) — please prepare tailored outreach once we have the short customer note.
Jordan (AM): On standby. Include an option for a live walkthrough and offer credit.
Tom (SRE): Mitigation: scaling workers by +30% and enabling a short retry-backoff to smooth spikes. Applying now, ETA 8m.
Ivy (Eng): For VPC/private setups we cannot reroute; we'll schedule prioritized reprocessing after the queue drains.
Maya (CS): Draft short note for review please — keep it non-technical, 3 bullets max.
Maya (CS): ```
Hi <Customer Team>,
Quick update: some onboarding imports experienced delays starting ~03:00 UTC due to a transient backend processing spike, which caused timeouts for some webhook-based uploads.
What we did: scaled processing capacity and prioritized reprocessing for affected jobs. VPC customers will receive a safe, prioritized retry once systems are healthy.
ETA: we expect affected imports to complete within 2045 minutes. No customer data was exposed.
Next steps: we'll confirm when your import finishes and apply a one-time account credit. If you'd like a walkthrough, book a slot here: <link>.
Thanks,
Maya on behalf of Redwood Inference Ops
```
Tom (SRE): +1. Add that we'll share an RCA timeline (initial 24h, full 72h).
Maya (CS): Added. Sending to Jordan for personalization.
ops-bot: Reprocess job finished at 03:14 UTC. Posting impacted tenants: alpha-corp, beta-studios, gamma-pilot. (automated) :gear:
Jordan (AM): Sent to alpha-corp and beta-studios with exec exec-contact lines and booked a walkthrough for gamma-pilot.
Evelyn (CS Lead): Good. Please paste sent comms here for audit. We'll close the CS task after confirmations.
Maya (CS): Pasting sent to alpha-corp: Subject: Brief update on import delay — resolved. Body: Hi <Name>, we had a brief processing incident; your import has been prioritized and completed. No data exposure. One-time credit applied. Thanks, Maya.
Ivy (Eng): We'll follow up with the RCA and propose throttling + better autoscaling during spikes.
Tom (SRE): Monitoring for 2 hours; if stable we'll resolve the incident.
Maya (CS): Thanks everyone. Closing once final confirmations are in and the RCA is posted.
